note: Popup Field Group provides one field_group FieldGroupFormatter plugin, id 'popup' (supported contexts form and view). A popup group is stored in a display config entity's third_party_settings.field_group.<group_name> with format_type: popup and a format_settings map (popup_link show/text/classes, popup_labels title/close_text, popup_settings modal/position/etc). No settings page, permission, or Drush. Medium cases read back a known popup group's formatter/settings from the live display config; hard cases require the agent to add a popup field group to a display and verify checks that some group on that display has format_type === 'popup'. All state is display config (no field storage or router rebuild), so cases are fully verifiable on this shared site.

evals.prompt: The Drupal contrib module popup_field_group extends Field Group. What new group type does it add, and how do you use it on a content type?
evals.expected_output: It adds a Field Group formatter with id 'popup' (label 'Popup'). On Manage display or Manage form display, click Add group, choose Popup, then place fields inside; the group's children render hidden and open in a dialog via an 'Open popup' link.

evals.prompt: Can the popup_field_group 'Popup' group be used on the rendered entity display, on the edit form, or both?
evals.expected_output: Both: the popup FieldGroupFormatter declares supported_contexts of 'form' and 'view', so it works on Manage form display and Manage display.

evals.prompt: What are the main configurable options of a popup_field_group Popup group (the trigger link and the dialog)?
evals.expected_output: format_settings has popup_link (show/text/classes for the trigger), popup_labels (title, close_text), and popup_settings (modal, dialog_class, close_on_escape, height/width family, position_horizontal, position_vertical, append_to), plus optional extra_css.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type's default form display has a field group named group_pfg_known. Inspect the live configuration: which Field Group formatter (format type) does it use, and what is its 'Open popup' link text?
evals.expected_output: group_pfg_known uses format_type: popup, with format_settings.popup_link.text = 'Open the gallery'.

evals.prompt: The Article default form display on this site has a popup_field_group group named group_pfg_modal. Inspect the live configuration and state whether its dialog is configured as a modal or non-modal popup.
evals.expected_output: group_pfg_modal has format_settings.popup_settings.modal = 0, i.e. a non-modal (floating) dialog.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a popup_field_group 'Popup' field group to the Article content type's default form display (Manage form display). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The node.article default entity_form_display has a field group in third_party_settings.field_group with format_type = popup.

evals.prompt: On my Article pages I want some content to open in a pop-up dialog instead of showing inline. Using the pop-up field group feature, set up a pop-up group on the Article content display (the way Article pages are shown).
evals.expected_output: The node.article default entity_view_display has a field group in third_party_settings.field_group with format_type = popup.
